title: agent_manifest/v1
description: Attribution record for WHO decided: the agent's identity, adapter, egress allowlist, and frozen inference configuration. Chained via bundle_manifest.agent_manifest_sha256 and the chain genesis. Secret-free BY CONSTRUCTION (SEC-1): no field in this schema can legally hold a credential - endpoint DOMAINS not URLs-with-tokens, prompt HASH not prompt text, scalar-only inference params (decimals as strings; this manifest is hashed, so the no-floats rule applies to it like everything else).

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

name.description: Human-readable agent name chosen by the operator, e.g. 'baseline-flat' or 'my-llm-agent'.

adapter.description: IC-6 transport: HTTP container (V1 canonical) or in-process scripted reference agent. 'mcp' is reserved post-V1.

model_id.description: Model identifier as invoked/billed (e.g. provider model slug); 'none' for scripted agents. Attribution: who decided.

items.description: One exact lowercase DNS hostname (>= 2 dot-separated LDH labels, e.g. 'api.example.com'). The pattern forbids ':', '/', '@', '?', '#' and whitespace outright, so a scheme, port, path, query, or userinfo credential (user:pass@host) is schema-INVALID - the SEC-1 'secret-free by construction' claim is enforced by construction, not convention.

endpoint_domains.description: EXHAUSTIVE egress allowlist driving the sandbox lockdown (ISO-2): only these domains are reachable from the agent container; every other attempt is refused AND recorded as an EgressBlocked event. Empty array = fully offline agent. Items are bare hostnames only (pattern-enforced): a URL-with-embedded-token cannot legally appear here.

inference_params.description: Inference settings verbatim, scalar values only. Decimal-valued params (e.g. temperature) MUST be decimal strings ('0.7'), never JSON numbers with fractional parts - this document is hashed.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar setting value; decimals as strings.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the system/base prompt bytes - configuration commitment without forced disclosure (prompt text itself is user-side and optional). Null when the agent has no prompt (scripted agents).

agent_version.description: Free-form agent code version string, or null.

image_sha256.description: Pinned Docker image digest of the agent container ('sha256:...'); null for in-process scripted agents. Reproducibility artifact.

declared_by.description: Optional free-text attribution of who declared this manifest (operator handle). The 'principal' slot of a commerce mandate.

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md). Hashed as-is; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value), and never credentials.

ext_value.description: JCS-safe extension value (DET-2): null, boolean, string, integer within the I-JSON exact range +/-(2^53-1), or arrays/objects of the same, recursively. A JSON number with a fractional part (e.g. 1.5) is schema-INVALID here - ext contents ride into hashed documents as-is, and no fractional number may enter a hashed document. Boundary note: JSON Schema's 'integer' type admits a mathematically-integral literal such as 1.0; the CI instance scan (float-rejecting JSON parse, see VERSIONING.md) closes that remaining lexical gap.

anyOf.description: JSON string (decimal values ride as strings, e.g. '0.7').
Integer within the I-JSON exact range (JCS round-trips it byte-identically).
Object whose values are all JCS-safe.
